name: Source control
description: Where your code lives and changes are reviewed.

name: CI (build + test)
description: Builds and tests every change automatically.

name: Build / package
description: Turns your code into something you can ship, usually a container image.

name: Infrastructure (IaC)
description: Creates servers, networks and databases from code instead of clicking around.

name: Deploy / CD
description: Gets the new version onto the runtime.

name: Secrets
description: Keeps API keys and passwords out of your code.

name: Monitoring / logs
description: Tells you when things break, ideally before your users do.
